justification: Inspected [NMethodInfo.java](ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/nmethod/NMethodInfo.java) and [AbstractNMethodStage.java](ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/nmethod/AbstractNMethodStage.java). NMethodInfo is 259 lines with 12 methods total, only 2 public (`setInfo`, `clear`), and the private methods are small helpers for one cohesive purpose: building a two-column JavaFX info panel, adding prev/next compilation controls, and populating/clearing labels. The class does not show multiple unrelated responsibilities or dense logic that would indicate insufficient modularization.
